title: Risk Detector

title: Advanced Data Analytics

title: SQL Analytics
description: Deep-dive SQL analytics project covering complex multi-table joins, window functions, CTEs, and query optimisation to turn raw relational data into actionable business intelligence.

title: Analytic Projects
description: Domain-spanning analytics case studies where each notebook follows the full data workflow: acquire, clean, explore, model, and communicate findings with interactive visualisations.

title: Project Fur Baby

title: BookInn

title: Craftfolio

title: Projectspace
